name: Ring of Distant Travels
body:
Aura faint transmutation, faint divination, faint abjuration; CL 1st; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a traveler’s ring and functions as such. Any use of teleport, dimension door, or any other spell which allows for instant transportation of the wearer sends the wearer to a random point 5d100 miles from her point of origin instead of the intended location.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it. In this event, the ring may be removed but the ring and enchantment remain intact.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items traveler’s ring

Identification DC 26
False Identification DC 16
